title: Keeping the Lebanese army weak: A hardened US military doctrine at Israel's service
summary: As Lebanon marks a month since “Black Wednesday”, when massive Israeli strikes killed 361 people, the international community continues to call on the Lebanese army to disarm Hezbollah.
